ledger: Dance studio interior with wooden floor
Left wall: two black doors with green EXIT signs
Front wall: large mirror reflecting the room and the woman

findings.description: The green EXIT signs reflected in the mirror read normally from left to right. In a true mirror reflection, the text should be reversed.

The woman has a tattoo on her right arm. In the mirror, the tattoo appears on the left side of the reflected image (the reflection's right arm). A true mirror would show the tattoo on the right side of the reflected image.
